_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco routers, operator's model 14 Sep 2026. SKU family tokens first, then names, then the stored series labels (cords, kits, modules with no family token). More specific series are listed before broader ones that would also match (Secure Router G2 before Catalyst 8200/8300; ISR 800 bare model numbers before Cisco 8000).
